supplierPortalContact.emailLaterHint: You can leave out the email and add it later on the customer's Access page. Without an email nothing is sent.
supplierPortalContact.needNameOrEmail: Give the customer's company name or an email address.
supplierPortalContact.linkSent: The link to your security profile was sent to {email}.
supplierPortalContact.addEmailBody: The link to your security profile is sent to this address.
supplierPortalContact.changeEmailBody: The link to your security profile is sent to the new address. The current link stops working, so {email} loses access.
supplierPortalContact.removeAccessBody: Their link to your security profile stops working and nothing is sent to this address any more. The customer stays in your list, and you can add another email later.
supplierPortalContact.accessRemoved: Access removed. The customer is still in your list.
supplierPortalContact.ownAccountNote: This customer has its own account and is reached at the address it keeps there.
